description: Search England's Register of Parks and Gardens of Special Historic Interest by name: grade, date registered, area in hectares and official link. For garden visitors, estate owners and planners (registration is a planning consideration). Source: Historic England National Heritage List for England. Name match only; covers registered landscapes, not every public park. (cost: 1 credit)

name.description: string, required, part of the park or garden name, e.g. 'Kew' (case-insensitive, 2-100 chars)

name: historic_park_garden_search
